facts.fact: FAO says EOSTAT Phase II, launched with the Ministry of Lands, Agriculture, Fisheries, Water and Rural Development, will make satellite crop type mapping routine and expand Earth-observation tools for drought and flood early warning, after a first phase that produced a 2023 winter wheat map, a 2023/24 summer crop type map and pilot drought and flood tools.

systems.platform: Earth observation time series and anomaly detection
systems.owner: FAO with ZIMSTAT, ZINGSA, SIRDC, ZCHPC and the Meteorological Services Department
